body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by an Action or would suffer forced movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action or reduce the forced movement by 2 units. If you are in a Bulwark Adaptation, choose both.

surges.html: After this Reaction resolves, remove Chilled, Shocked, or Concussed from yourself.
After this Reaction resolves, remove Unstable.
